title: Variance Partitioning Analysis
code: sim_data <- function(n, beta, sigSq_g, rho, n_random, intercept, link, signal_frac = NULL, theta=NULL){    # Create fixed covariates with given correlation rho   Sigma <- matrix(c(1,rho,rho,1), 2)   X <- scale(rmvnorm(n, c(0,0), Sigma))    # random effecdt with n_random levels   z <- factor(sample(seq(n_random), n, replace=TRUE))    # Sparse design matrix for random effects   df <- data.frame(X, z)   Z <- sparse.model.matrix(~ 0 + z, df)    # Simulate random effect   alpha <- rnorm(ncol(Z), 0, sd=sqrt(sigSq_g))    # linear predictor based on interceptm, fixed & random effects   eta <- intercept + as.matrix(X %*% beta + Z %*% alpha)    # noise in Gaussian model   sigSq_e <- (1-signal_frac)/signal_frac * var(eta)[1]    # Simulate response   df$y <- switch(link,      "gaussian" = eta + rnorm(n, 0, sd = sqrt(sigSq_e)),     "poisson" = rpois(n, exp(eta)),     "logistic" = rbinom(n, 1, prob=plogis(eta)),     "nb" = rnegbin(n, exp(eta), theta = theta))    # Unexplained variance for each model   sigSq_noise <- switch(link,      "gaussian" = sigSq_e,     "poisson" =  trigamma(exp(intercept)),     "logistic" = pi^2 / 3,     "nb" = trigamma(1/(1/exp(intercept) + 1/theta)))    # variance components   # varTotal =    # vc = c(beta^2, sigSq_g, sigSq_noise)    signal_frac = var(eta)[1] / (var(eta)[1] + sigSq_noise)    a = c(beta^2, sigSq_g)   vc = c(signal_frac * a/sum(a), 1 - signal_frac)    attr(df, "varFrac") = vc / sum(vc)   df }   df <- sim_data(n = 1e6,                beta = c(1,2),                sigSq_g = 2,               rho = .7,                n_random = 1000,               intercept = 3,               "gaussian",               signal_frac = .8)   fit <- fastlmm(y ~ X1 + X2 + (1|z), df)  varpart(fit) ##        X1        X2         z Residuals  ## 0.1159611 0.4638733 0.2202469 0.1999187 attr(df, "varFrac") ## [1] 0.1142857 0.4571429 0.2285714 0.2000000
